frozenPredeclaredWindows.objectCoordinates: u,v normalized to each independently registered complete table exterior, including any visible frame; xMin,xMax,yMin,yMax
frozenPredeclaredWindows.registration: Map frozen envelopes through actual study-pane bounds (plotting area, excluding axes). Register the complete table exterior using all visible boundary segments, independent of text/model. Missing/ambiguous boundaries hold that property; never move/enlarge an envelope after inspection. All body/text/divider/frame coordinates are local to the named object, never a union of tables.
frozenPredeclaredWindows.textRule: All glyphs of the exact named literal must be readable in its own frozen window; presence elsewhere or partial/inferred text gives zero credit.
frozenPredeclaredWindows.dividerRule: Upper/lower divider bands require a vertical separator with colored body on either side; horizontal outer borders and caption ink cannot supply it. Score full blue merged span and absence/presence of orange HIDDEN body separately. Whole table outside the fixed envelope or unreadable lower control is NOT OBSERVED.

windowFindings.body: Complete blue table body across its independently registered exterior.
windowFindings.text/subjectMERGED: Complete literal MERGED readable in the full subject window.
windowFindings.text/subjectHIDDENcandidate: No separate HIDDEN word. The right part of the complete MERGED caption crosses this window and is not counted as HIDDEN.
windowFindings.body/subjectFull: Blue background across full actual exterior; caption antialias is separate.
windowFindings.body/subjectRight: Right local half remains blue; no orange second-cell background.
windowFindings.divider/1: Blue body across upper fixed strip, no vertical white separator.
windowFindings.divider/2: Blue body across lower independent fixed strip, no vertical white separator.

windowFindings.body: Complete separate blue left and orange right control cells with white vertical separator.
windowFindings.text/controlMERGED: Complete literal MERGED in own left-half window.
windowFindings.text/controlHIDDEN: Complete literal HIDDEN in own right-half window.
windowFindings.body/controlLeft: Blue left cell; the local half includes the left portion of the white divider at its boundary.
windowFindings.body/controlRight: Orange right cell; the local half includes the right portion of the white divider at its boundary.
windowFindings.divider/1: White vertical x942..945 separator with blue/orange body on either side, upper strip outside caption ink.
windowFindings.divider/2: Same white separator independently visible in lower strip outside caption ink.

pixelCoverageRule: Conservative original pixel cells intersecting each continuous fixed window: floor minima, ceil maxima exclusive; full row RLE and raw channel histogram, no color conversion or synthetic alpha
scope: Complete per-object fixed envelopes, exterior registration, body/text/individual frame bands/divider strips; raw scan pointers do not complete unreadable glyphs or infer occluded structures.
